classification: controlled development; not independent validation or real-football calibration

events.completion: intended receiver physically touches original pass episode before opponent control/restart; not delivery proximity
events.retained: receiver controls original episode AND own team owns the ball one second later; endpoint censored if unavailable
events.shot: goal from requested released shotId before episode outcome, not a later team goal
events.defensive: separate fixed-target 0.8m proximity, finite-foot access, executed disruption, defender control; no inference of contact from ETA

information: bounded scene retained; legacy forecasts explicitly privileged; hidden opponent ratings never passed into bounded scene
selection: one experimentally requested action, possibly rejected, followed by autonomous canonical 40Hz football
